name: claude-code-mods
description: Claude Mods and the tools to build them: a builder skill, then mods.

plugins.name: mod-builder
plugins.description: A skill that plans, writes, validates and reviews a Claude Mod. Every idea must justify each process, file, network, model or UI capability it requests: plan first, smallest $ surface, validator output pasted, a five-line threat model. A brainstorm mode checks ideas against every mod already on GitHub.
